actions.reason: The Verifier describes K6_C0001 as internally cohesive and single-cluster-dominant in the fused geometry, with a coherent proliferation-high, OXPHOS-low expression program and a near-universal PBRM1-mutated profile that survives both multiplicity families. The structural report notes only a modest boundary to K6_C0004, but the RNA report shows the two sets have opposite proliferation-program directions, so the soft boundary does not undermine the distinct phenotype. The stated limitations (composite rest group, small set size, post-hoc driver panel) are acknowledged but do not outweigh the convergent biological and mutational characterization.

The Verifier describes K6_C0002 as internally cohesive and single-cluster-dominant, with a coherent immune-low, OXPHOS-high expression program and a mutational profile of VHL and PBRM1 depletion (VHL surviving global correction). The modest structural boundary to K6_C0003 is not in conflict because the RNA reports show opposite immune-program directions between the two sets. The composite-rest contrast and small set size are acknowledged limitations but do not negate the coherent phenotype.

The Verifier describes K6_C0003 as internally cohesive and single-cluster-dominant, with a coherent immune-high, mesenchymal-low expression program. The WXS report is largely null at the multiplicity-corrected level, which is a not-estimable/absent mutational signal rather than a contradiction of the expression phenotype; the two dimensions measure different axes. The modest boundary to K6_C0002 is offset by the opposite immune-program directions reported for the two sets.

The Verifier describes K6_C0004 as internally cohesive and single-cluster-dominant, with a coherent immune-low, proliferation-low, mesenchymal-low expression program. The WXS report is largely null at the multiplicity-corrected level, which does not contradict the expression phenotype. The modest structural boundary to K6_C0001 is offset by the opposite proliferation-program directions reported for the two sets.

The Verifier describes K6_C0005 as internally cohesive and single-cluster-dominant, with a coherent immune-high, inflammatory-high expression program and a BAP1-enriched mutational profile surviving both multiplicity families. The known-label report notes elevated M1 and G4 in this set, which is a clinical association rather than independent validation and does not establish that the set is clinically defined; it does not outweigh the convergent expression and mutational characterization. The modest boundary to K6_C0003 is acknowledged.

The Verifier describes K6_C0006 as internally cohesive and single-cluster-dominant, with a coherent mesenchymal-high, OXPHOS-low expression program and a joint VHL-high, PBRM1-absent mutational profile. The smallest set size and the composite-rest contrast are acknowledged limitations, but the convergent expression and mutational characterization supports retaining the candidate. The modest boundary to K6_C0004 is offset by the opposite EMT-program directions reported for the two sets.
